prompt: Use case: product-mockup. ONE original photorealistic Vietnamese bamboo/rattan catalog product. Subject: three-tier brochure display with empty woven pockets and a rigid bamboo frame; front scooped pocket edges, right side triangular support, rear crossed braces. Style Royal: formal symmetry and graceful bound borders without emblems. Relative size medium within its class. Principal weave regular open hexagonal cane lattice with three strip directions, finish cinnabar red lacquer retaining clearly visible woven strip intersections. Smooth bound joints, continuous strips, stable bamboo/wood supports and only described plain secondary materials. Interiors empty. CAMERA exact front elevation azimuth0, directly facing described front, level with product center, no overhead or three-quarter angle. Full product centered with generous margins, warm-white seamless studio backdrop, soft light/subtle shadow, sharp fiber texture, square. Canonical front for other views. No props, signs, cards, sample goods, room, people, animals, plants, food, extra products, collage or diagram. ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT: no letters, numbers, labels, logos, captions, watermarks, symbols, inscriptions or measurements.

visual_review.method: manual comparison of canonical front and three-view review sheet
